poi.srGoal: {name}: at the site centre, {elev} m altitude.
analysis.title: Analysis of {site}
analysis.bestHelp: The {count} start dates with the most Sun (ties broken by more Earth) between {from} and {to}, without overlap.
analysis.noWindows: There are no windows of that length in the data.
analysis.calendarHelp: Each row is a day and each column a UTC hour. Gold: Sun above the terrain horizon. White: Earth above the horizon.
analysis.skyHelp: Path of the Sun and Earth over 30 days against the terrain horizon. The centre is 30° elevation and the edge −5°; faint dots are hidden by the terrain.
analysis.compareHelp: Same start date and the same window ({days} days) at every site; the best percentage is in green.
analysis.dataNote: All numbers use the horizon at each region's centre, not at a specific landing point, and the Sun counts as visible when its upper limb clears the horizon.
